result.keyword: What's the best project management tool for a startup?
result.markdown:
For most startups, **Linear is my top recommendation** if you're building a tech product. But the best tool depends on your team size, workflow, and whether you're managing software development, business operations, or both.

A startup needs a project management tool that is\:

- **Easy to adopt\:** Minimal training and administrative overhead.
- **Flexible\:** Can evolve as the team grows.
- **Collaborative\:** Keeps tasks, owners, deadlines, and decisions visible.
- **Affordable\:** Doesn't become expensive as you hire.
- **Integrated\:** Connects with Slack, GitHub, Google Workspace, and other tools.

## Best project management tools for startups

![Projects – Linear Docs](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/H7btCzSbelKXdMr_2WS3GWddG9qajBq9JZDHM8HYyOoLV6E4HDh5vlzogddffE6t5gTnGdoZ53UsXuMyPZWPmHRUwQ3ddApfS44CKAri923rLMIeylRQs9HZxmyB23G0rTfX3tmbKwJPdUtZW_x9bJsI8X8b5_Xrbg_k3vvdE22XkcL7igbp9gCGi9QLirCv?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. Linear**

(Best for tech startups)

- Excellent product roadmaps and sprint planning.
- Great for engineering teams.
- Fast, clean interface.
- GitHub integration.

My pick for SaaS and software startups.

[Explore Linear](https://linear.app)

---

![Finastra Customer Story | ClickUp™](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/OXxUksa73j7hoTxbYQ6zo3pspX36GflPBLMsRWXjhfWZTJdFq6md_tXaxCCc_3Kjh0xQSrUSgXoCYi3d5TOe48r-mvzFwLplQbgf4lhsH3q_bsATt_hAcyva5qI1DtZG8OasgRxxldReZAIfURcJdNdt2Br8nPVvqn-lCO5aR2MxpFl9QAiCxibf4gzehOOb?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. ClickUp**

(Best all-in-one solution)

- Tasks, docs, goals, and dashboards.
- Highly customizable.
- Useful for marketing, operations, and product.
- Generous free starting option.

Best if you want one platform for the entire company.

[Explore ClickUp](https://clickup.com)

---

![Project Management Hub Template by Gridvio | Notion Marketplace](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/6e1oG6Y_aW5V5yDl222hE8Y8t-T__05L0OPLqrtY2b6KrmvS_M-QH4eaVLv4afPJUAGCFGr_eoifL-Irt3_HiUqUmKW08dRjhIxW2MfVWL_nPAWNaujkMp5zdq2VbJkW7b3h6jvrTVNAFmmVU9MPLCBztqWrhslDc_LeRhpbcV451et11onvlpgBLkBnIYcR?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. Notion**

- Project management and company wiki.
- Meeting notes and documentation.
- Startup operating procedures.
- Flexible databases.

Best for early-stage founding teams.

[Explore Notion](https://notion.so)

---

![New: Asana’s Milestones help you visualize project progress • Asana](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/045PY8MNTZCNbuEY_9zoc2ZmyVm82bEUQrACKq4DMJ2rZRzBOKtwnHDDeSB865DF__R-b4CGI6GEhHdu4YJMzkB1qcjJuCRLXmMhkxG9zfIfGx-0L1EgDFt_aMUwOdh5HR45ijTcFpeq8HRM8juB5v_Vffpp7OzTfiaEKInBCXkUCm5590f5v87DKC8sKsga?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. Asana**

- Clear task ownership.
- Project timelines and dependencies.
- Cross-functional collaboration.
- Good reporting.

Best for teams coordinating multiple departments.

[Explore Asana](https://asana.com)

---

![Portfolio management - All Projects Dashboard – Support](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/-5NH-hROEcQXpSQPmMUJv0x7GODAoqXeNRlBaAmeb5yjL6ws1fsUSsHXZKs7cGHwGwKjC6qsKZvaA0-fO7oD8-9_bc-PbX0_EJ1QpOPifoMbrdCVNNuollQzaJIhYGySdgXpxRYlPlDaiOA8sl0RXCUZIj48mjl4S_hb7oB4Rygmeul72nI4kZxZvS769XKO?purpose=fullsize)

**5\. Monday.com**

- Visual project boards.
- Automations and dashboards.
- Marketing and sales workflows.
- Easy-to-understand interface.

Best for non-technical and operations-heavy startups.

[Explore Monday.com](https://monday.com)

## My recommendation by startup stage

| Startup situation | My pick |
|--------|--------|
| 1–3 founders | Notion |
| 3–10 employees | ClickUp |
| SaaS / tech startup | Linear |
| 10–30 employees | Asana |
| Operations-heavy business | Monday.com |
| Very limited budget | ClickUp |
